David checks out the Razer Naga V3 Pro, which has up to 23 buttons, swappable side plates, and a fourth finger button he didn’t know he needed. It also costs $180, caps out at 1000Hz out of the box, wants you to buy extras for 8K polling and wireless charging, and doesn’t work with the Synapse web app. He brought in a MOBA player to see if it’s still worth it for the people it’s actually made for.
